title: pm-dispatch(lanes): the skills, spec and ui charters point at the lane self-triage exception instead of restating the old absolute
body:
Fixes #27326
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么:skills、spec、ui 三份车道岗位说明各改一行,不再重述「车道席绝不自分诊」的旧绝对句,改为指向 `triage-duties.md` 车道席自分诊例外。
- 为什么改:例外已写进 `triage-duties.md`,只读自己岗位说明的席位仍会读到旧规则,与技能本体自相矛盾;规则文字仍只写一处。
- 风险与回滚:仅内部指令文本(`.claude/**`,Tier S),不发布任何包;回滚即 revert 本 PR,三行恢复原文。
- 先看:`references/lanes/ui.md` L8(为挤进 120 字节删了「同笔」二字与指针两侧空格,见下);其次 `lanes/skills.md` L22、`lanes/spec.md` L29。
- 两分钟验证:`pnpm check:pm-skill-ratchet`,预期三文件行数 32/42/23 不变、全绿。
- 需要你做的:无,席位落地(Tier S 契约复核)。

## What changes

Three in-place line edits, net 0 lines per file, each line within the 120-byte budget. Each line keeps its lane content and names the exception's home (`triage-duties.md`, 自分诊) instead of restating the absolute; no new rule text.

| file:line | before (bytes) | after (bytes) |
|---|---|---|
| `lanes/skills.md` L22 | 「- 本车道 finding 同走分诊席首触,⛔ 不自分诊;席位可附证据与「仪器为车队服务」的答案。」 (119) | 「- 本车道 finding 归分诊首触,自分诊见 `triage-duties.md`;可附证据与「仪器为车队服务」答案。」 (119) |
| `lanes/spec.md` L29 | 「- findings 首触定级归分诊席,本席只供证据。」 (57) | 「- findings 首触定级归分诊席,本席只供证据;例外见 `triage-duties.md` 车道席自分诊。」 (105) |
| `lanes/ui.md` L8 | 「- ⛔ 不产 `domain:*`、type 与定级,分诊唯一生产;误标 `pm:retriage`+异议同笔,整树归本席除外。」 (118) | 「- ⛔ 不产 `domain:*`、type,定级仅`triage-duties.md`自分诊;误标 `pm:retriage`+异议,整树归本席除外。」 (120) |

Line counts: `skills.md` 32 to 32 (ceiling 33), `spec.md` 42 to 42 (ceiling 43), `ui.md` 23 to 23 (ceiling 23). Headroom not spent.

## Tests

No code, no published surface (`.claude/**` only), so no unit tests and no changeset (`skip-changeset`). The gate union derived by `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (17 families) ran green on head `f65fff31`; see Verification.

## Acceptance notes

- `ui.md` L8 byte budget: the dispatch hypothesis gave this line 2 B of room once 「分诊唯一生产」 is displaced. Measured, every wording that keeps 「定级」, 「自分诊」 and the full file name plus the untouched remainder lands at 128 B or more (the remainder alone is 89 B; the grade clause with the pointer is 39 B). To fit 120 B without spending the 0-line headroom, two things went: the spaces around the pointer's code span, and 「同笔」 in the mislabel clause (the same-stroke rule keeps its general home in `references/cross-repo-coordination.md` L32, 「误标挂 `pm:retriage`+异议同笔」). `domain:*` and `type` stay absolute and the pointer attaches to 定级 alone, so it does not read as a `domain:*` exception (triage-duties L32: 不改 `domain:*`). 「整树归本席除外」 is unchanged. If the seat prefers keeping 「同笔」, the alternative is dropping `.md` and 「归」 from 「整树归本席除外」, which the dispatch said stays.
- `skills.md` L22 keeps 「仪器为车队服务」; to fit, 「同走分诊席」 became 「归分诊」 and 「席位…的答案」 became 「…答案」.
- Out of scope, not edited (single-file-surface claim): `references/cross-repo-coordination.md` L31 still says 「执行席永不定级或路由裸卡」, the same absolute this card retires, in the multi-lane-repo section. Same family as this card; reported to the seat, not filed.
- `skills.md` L23 (「…⛔ 不自入队;定级归分诊。」) covers findings that cannot answer the instrument question (p3 or drop), outside the exception's p1/p2 own-in-flight scope, so no contradiction; left as is.
